# Encode the target variable
df['patient_outcome'] = df['patient_outcome'].map({'malignant': 1, 'benign': 0})

# Fill missing values with the mean of each column
df.fillna(df.mean(numeric_only=True), inplace=True)

# Separate features and target variable
X = df.drop('patient_outcome', axis=1)
y = df['patient_outcome']

# Calculate mutual information
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif

# Calculate mutual information
mutual_info = mutual_info_classif(X, y, discrete_features='auto')

# Create a DataFrame for mutual information results
mutual_info_df = pd.DataFrame(mutual_info, index=X.columns, columns=['Mutual Information']).sort_values(by='Mutual Information', ascending=False)

# Get the top 5 features
top_features = mutual_info_df.head(5)
top_features

from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.metrics import make_scorer, accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score

# Select the top 5 features
X_top5 = X[top_features.index]

# Initialize the SVM classifier
svm_classifier = SVC()

# Perform cross-validation
accuracy = cross_val_score(svm_classifier, X_top5, y, cv=5, scoring='accuracy')
precision = cross_val_score(svm_classifier, X_top5, y, cv=5, scoring=make_scorer(precision_score))
recall = cross_val_score(svm_classifier, X_top5, y, cv=5, scoring=make_scorer(recall_score))

# Calculate mean scores
mean_accuracy = accuracy.mean()
mean_precision = precision.mean()
mean_recall = recall.mean()

mean_accuracy, mean_precision, mean_recall

from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Standardize the data
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_top5)

# Apply PCA
pca = PCA(n_components=2)
X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_scaled)

# Plot the PCA results
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.scatter(X_pca[:, 0], X_pca[:, 1], c=y, cmap='viridis', edgecolor='k', s=50)
plt.title('PCA of Patient Readmission Data')
plt.xlabel('Principal Component 1')
plt.ylabel('Principal Component 2')
plt.colorbar(label='Patient Outcome (0: Benign, 1: Malignant)')
plt.grid()
plt.show()

# Save the PCA plot as an image file
